title: Limits of the diaphane
html_source: Diaphane: the transparent. The term relates to Aristotle’s theory of light . He thought translucence resided within bodies and the degree to which bodies partake of translucence causes colour (Gifford. Annotated Ulysses, p 45).

anchor.prefix: o more, thought through my eyes. Signatures of all things I am here to read, seaspawn and seawrack, the nearing tide, that rusty boot. Snotgreen, bluesilver, rust: coloured signs.
anchor.suffix: . But he adds: in bodies. Then he was aware of them bodies before of them coloured. How? By knocking his sconce against them, sure. Go easy. Bald he was and a millionaire, maestro
